description: Per-channel planning priors and rules derived from the bp 2026 Investment Communications brief and the7stars historical bp campaign performance (BigQuery). Synthetic demo values for prototype reasoning, not final investment advice.

objective.budget_guardrail: Every pound must reach the Global Business Elite in brand-safe, premium environments; plans should show audience-quality rationale and test risk separately.

channel_rules.planning_role: Premium, brand-safe reach into the Global Business Elite at home: financial news and premium broadcaster VOD, where bp's investment story gets full-screen, sound-on attention.
channel_rules.mmm_note: the7stars campaign history shows CTV as bp's strongest driver of GBE view-through and completed views, with efficient reach up to roughly £260k a month before frequency builds faster than new GBE reach.
channel_rules.phasing_rule: Hold an always-on premium presence; concentrate weight in the two weeks around each results announcement, the AGM and the strategy update rather than spreading evenly.

channel_rules.planning_role: Precision targeting of GBE readers through private marketplace deals with financial publishers and contextual keyword targeting around energy, markets and capital allocation.
channel_rules.mmm_note: Historical bp display delivery shows financial-publisher PMPs reaching GBE at the highest audience quality in the mix, with viewability well above open-exchange benchmarks but a lower engagement rate than video.
channel_rules.phasing_rule: Keep an always-on contextual layer; lift PMP weight in results weeks and around energy conferences when financial-publisher readership peaks.

channel_rules.planning_role: Explain the equity story in more depth: pre-roll on business and financial content and publisher video, building consideration among investors and analysts.
channel_rules.mmm_note: Online video has a shorter bp history than CTV, so the evidence is reasonable but lower-confidence - completion rates are strong on financial publisher video, weaker on broad YouTube placements.
channel_rules.phasing_rule: Use around results and the strategy update to carry longer-form explainer content; keep as a measured test outside those windows.

channel_rules.planning_role: Amplify results, AGM and conference moments to financial professionals with interest- and job-title-proxy audiences; cheapest reach but the least precise GBE targeting.
channel_rules.mmm_note: Meta is brief-required but GBE targeting relies on interest and professional proxies, so it is treated as a measurement-led amplification layer rather than a proven GBE channel.
channel_rules.phasing_rule: Concentrate around results days, the AGM and major energy conferences; avoid thin always-on spend that drifts outside the GBE audience.

brief_test_criteria.label: Hits the brief target frame
brief_test_criteria.requirement: Generated plan should balance to the supplied 2026 budget and show whether forecast GBE engagements clear 3,400,000 at or below the £1.55 brief cost per engagement.

brief_test_criteria.label: Uses campaign history where available
brief_test_criteria.requirement: Channel rationales should cite the7stars BigQuery campaign history and identify any channel where the brief asks for more than the historical evidence supports.

brief_test_criteria.label: Responds to named brief priorities
brief_test_criteria.requirement: Plan QA should flag priority areas requiring explicit treatment: results season, AGM and strategy update, energy conferences, GBE precision, channel role clarity and measurement.

brief_test_criteria.label: Separates evidence gaps from confident recommendations
brief_test_criteria.requirement: Online Video and Meta should be tagged as measurement-led choices until IPSOS IGI validation confirms GBE match quality.
